matches.rationale: GT1 concerns Proposition 1's statement in the main text (normalized weighted average vs. simple weighted sum). Pred_id 2 flags a missing 1/n factor in Appendix A.1's *derivation* of Proposition 1, which is a different defect in a different location. No finding addresses the inconsistency between the stated formula and the normalization claim in the main text.

GT2 concerns the claim that the Monte Carlo estimator is unbiased (or approximately so) versus the standard theory that self-normalized importance sampling is biased. None of the three findings address this bias claim or Proposition 2's theoretical justification; they all focus on algebraic errors in different equations.
